_dev_notes: Placement question bank for the ESOL adaptive assessment.
Original 5 questions (one per level) have full translations in
ar / so / fa / zh. The 15 questions added on the December seed
pass have ENGLISH text in every language field as a placeholder —
they are content-complete and structurally valid but need real
translations before production. Look for ids ending in -002/-003/
-004 to find them.
Audio status: the original e2-listening-001, l1-listening-001 etc.
say 'Listen: ...' but the frontend does NOT play audio yet. They
function as reading questions in the meantime — the text after
'Listen:' is read by the learner. For honesty, the new-pass
questions use 'Read this announcement:' framing and are classified
as reading, NOT listening. Real listening (audio clips) lands when
TTS / recordings get wired into the placement page.
Answer-position distribution: deliberately balanced across A/B/C/D
(~5 each) so a learner can't game the test by guessing one letter.
Original 5 questions are unchanged; new 15 have been shuffled.
Runtime requirement: ≥ 4 questions per level (see
placement.service.ts PER_LEVEL_INITIAL). Validator (npm run
validate:placement-bank) wants 80 total with 4 per (level × domain)
cell — that's the production target. We currently sit at the
runtime minimum so the assessment can RUN, not at the full bar.
